valueProps.title: What sets {name} apart?
valueProps.aBody: MODELTREE is a hub for using and contributing to the world of 3D design. Whether you're seeking assets for your projects or offering your own creations, MODELTREE provides the platform and community to make it happen.
valueProps.bBody: Every model shows its licence and price up front, so you can budget a project without requesting a quote or negotiating terms.
valueProps.cBody: No more guesswork. The Quality Standard highlights the key technical characteristics of every file, including PBR textures, making it easier and faster to find the right models.

craft.title: High-quality, unique jewellery models
craft.body: Every model on {name} is real geometry, not a decorative mesh. Modelled in-house for casting and print, checked before it goes live, and described in the measurements a bench actually works to.
craft.watertightBody: Closed, manifold meshes that slice cleanly and hold their detail — no gaps around a shank, no facets that vanish on the build plate.
craft.dimensionsBody: Ring size, stone seat and metal weight in millimetres and grams, so you know the casting cost before you download.
craft.productionBody: Filter by how you produce, and get the formats that suit it — STL, Rhino, Matrix, 3Design and more, in one download.

custom.title: Need something unique? Let's create it
custom.body: Two ways to get a model that doesn't exist yet: hand the whole brief to our production team, or hire a designer directly.
custom.modelryStep1Body: Send us reference images or product links. No technical expertise needed.
custom.modelryStep2Body: We handle modeling, asset production, designer selection and in-house quality assurance.
custom.modelryStep3Body: Review and accept the final 3D model and images, ready for publishing.
custom.modelryBenefit4: Scalable production for thousands of SKUs
custom.projectsStep1Body: Describe your project with requirements, budget and timeline.
custom.projectsStep2Body: Browse designers who applied for your job, compare their portfolios and offered prices, then choose who to work with.
custom.projectsStep3Body: Collaborate directly with the designer to finalize your 3D model.
custom.projectsBenefit1: Direct collaboration: talk to the designer
custom.projectsBenefit2: Flexible iterations: adjust designs as the brief evolves
custom.projectsBenefit3: Best-fit creative projects: ideal for custom or one-off work

business.title: {name} Business Account
business.body: Production-ready assets from verified designers, licensed for your whole team. Review the models you need instantly and move a project from concept to completion without procurement overhead.
business.aBody: Share 3D models with your team without the usual hassle. Store an asset once and it's available to everyone who needs it, with no duplicate purchases.
business.bBody: Make 3D asset purchases simpler with flexible billing options. Consolidate invoicing and stop chasing receipts, whether it's one purchase or a hundred.
business.cBody: We offer a range of flexible licensing options to suit your needs. Whether you need a simple license for personal use or a more comprehensive one for commercial projects, we have you covered.

pricing.title: Two models a month, every month
pricing.subtitle: Built for working jewelers. Pick any two pieces from the catalog each month, keep the licences whether or not you stay, and reach our modelling team directly when a piece needs changing.
pricing.vat: Prices exclude VAT. Charged in shekels.
pricing.freeTagline: Browse everything, buy what you need
pricing.memberTagline: Two models every month, plus direct access to our modelers
pricing.memberF1: 2 models free every month, your pick from the catalog
pricing.memberF2: Licences are yours to keep, even if you cancel

pricing.memberF4: Member rates on size adjustments and edits

pricing.customF1: Ring resizes and small edits from a low fixed fee
pricing.customF2: Fully custom pieces modelled from your brief
pricing.customF3: Work directly with the modeler in chat
pricing.compareBody: Two models a month at catalog prices is typically more than the membership costs on its own — before the member rates on adjustments.
pricing.compareNote: Based on the current catalog. Your two picks can be any price.
pricing.faq1Q: What happens to my models if I cancel?
pricing.faq1A: They stay yours. Every model you take under the membership carries the same royalty-free licence as a purchase, and cancelling does not revoke it.
pricing.faq2A: Any two pieces in the catalog each month, at any price. There is no separate member-only shelf.
pricing.faq3A: Rollover has not been decided yet. Ask us before you subscribe and we will tell you where it stands.
pricing.faq4A: Open a chat from any model you own, say what needs changing, and a modeler quotes it. A ring resize costs a fraction of a new model.

custom.metaDescription: Chat directly with GoldTree's modelling team. Resize a ring you already bought, or have a piece modelled from scratch.
custom.title: Talk to a modeler, not a ticket queue
custom.subtitle: Every model here was built by our own modelers, and you can reach them. Whether a stone seat needs to move a millimetre or a customer wants something that does not exist yet, it starts as a chat.
custom.adjustTitle: Change a model you already own
custom.adjustBody: Ring sizing, stone dimensions, band width, engraving space. You bought the piece, so you are not paying to have it modelled again — you are paying for the edit.
custom.adjustPrice: Quoted per edit, far below a new model
custom.adjustE1: Resize a ring to your customer's finger
custom.adjustE2: Swap a 6.5mm seat for an 8x6 oval
custom.adjustE3: Thicken a shank for a heavier casting
custom.adjustE4: Add engraving space to a signet face
custom.newTitle: Commission a piece that does not exist
custom.newBody: Send reference photos, a sketch, or a customer's description. A modeler scopes it, quotes it, and builds it cast-ready. You approve before anything is delivered.
custom.newE1: Match a piece from a customer's photograph
custom.newE2: A one-off commission with a set stone list
custom.newE3: A full collection built on one design language
custom.newE4: Rework an old design for modern casting
custom.how1Body: From a model you own, or from scratch. Say what you need in Hebrew or English.
custom.how2Body: A modeler reads the brief, asks anything unclear, and prices the job before work starts.
custom.how3Body: You see the result before you accept it. Files arrive cast-ready in the formats you work in.
custom.memberBody: Membership includes two models a month and member rates on every adjustment. If you are sending work regularly, it pays for itself.
custom.howItWorksBody: You open a request here so the brief, the quote and the status stay on your account. The back-and-forth happens on WhatsApp, where the modelling team answers fastest.
